description: Status and results of one job whose job_id you have (from transcribe_url, transcribe_file or create_upload; list_jobs finds a lost job_id). While status is "waiting_for_upload", "queued" or "processing", call it again every 10-20 seconds; each answer has a next_step. "completed": the transcript in the chosen format, download links and zip_url (all results in one ZIP), plus summary, action_items and translations when requested. "payment_required": a preview of the first 100 words and a payment_url to show your user; call get_job again after they pay. "failed": an error message. "deleted": the files are gone (24 hours after the last activity, or delete_job).

format.description: Transcript format. "txt" (default): plain text. "srt" or "vtt": subtitles with timecodes. "timed": timestamps per segment, with speaker names if the job was created with speaker_labels: true.

job_id.description: job_id returned by transcribe_url or create_upload.

robot_key.description: The robot_key you received with your first job. Required to read or start your jobs.

name: get_job
title: Get job status and transcript
